paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Chayei Sarah 6. Hyman also finds R' Levi the Kohen bar Chalafta there, at Vayera 25.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Buber 1885 Tanchuma Chayei Sara 6 paragraph explicitly writes the abbreviated R' Chalafta bar Kahana; the whole Buber Vayera 25 paragraph writes R' Levi the Kohen bar Chalafta. Both locators therefore have named digital matches in Buber’s edition. The new English retains abbreviated R' titles and Hyman’s two separate notices; it does not infer a shared identity or reverse the patronymics. The earlier standard-Tanchuma lookup failures remain preserved, without Hebrew changes, printed-pixel verification, or importation of the surrounding teachings.
